content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD run-time statistics reporter (BSD header L1-44). SUBROUTINE STATISTICS (L52-190, history 05/06/2010 Fengyan Shi, USE GLOBAL L53 + USE TIDE_MODULE L54): over interior cells J=Jbeg,Jend / I=Ibeg,Iend accumulates MassVolume=SUM(Eta*DX*DY) for MASK(I,J)>0 cells (L80-82 CARTESIAN scalar DX,DY; L88-90 curvilinear DX(I,J)) and total Energy=SUM(0.5*g*H^2 + 0.5*u^2*H + 0.5*v^2*H)*DX*DY (L84-86 / L91-93; reference comments L76-77); computes MaxEta/MinEta via MAXVAL/MINVAL and MaxU/MaxV via MAXVAL(ABS()) over the interior (L98-101); scans for the max total speed Utotal=SQRT(U^2+V^2) on wet cells and records Fr=SQRT(GRAV*Max(H,MinDepthfrc)) at that cell (L104-114), falling back to Fr=SQRT(GRAV*MinDepthfrc) if never set (L115). Under PARALLEL, reduces MassVolume/Energy with MPI_SUM, MaxEta/MaxU/MaxV/UTotalMax/Fr with MPI_MAX, MinEta with MPI_MIN via MPI_ALLREDUCE into myvar (L117-134). Rank 0 (myid.eq.0 guard L139-141, L166-168) prints a STATISTICS block to screen (WRITE(*,...) L142-152) and to log unit 3 (WRITE(3,...) L154-164) using FORMAT 101 (6E12.4, L169): Time/DT, MassVolume/Energy/MaxEta/MinEta/MaxU/MaxV, UTotalMax/Fr/Froude=UTotalMax/Fr/Dmass, and tide boundary elevations TideWEST_ETA/TideEAST_ETA/TideSOUTH_ETA/TideNORTH_ETA when any of TideWest/TideEast/TideSouth/TideNorth is true (L149-152, L161-164). Then rank 0 calls CHECK_STATISTICS on each printed quantity (L175-184). SUBROUTINE CHECK_STATISTICS(val) (L192-210): if ISNAN(val) writes 'NaN detected in statistics, stopping simulation!' to screen and unit 3 (L200-201), calls MPI_ABORT with code 9 under PARALLEL (L204), then STOP (L206).
entities: REAL(SP) MassVolume,Energy,MaxEta,MinEta @L57; MaxU,MaxV,Fr,UTotal,UTotalMax @L58 (continuation); MaxM @L59 (continuation) — all initialized =ZERO in declaration

unresolved: MassVolume0 declared @L60, FirstCallStatistics declared/SAVEd @L61-62, and MaxM initialized @L59 are never used in the executable body (L69-190) — apparently vestigial
Dmass printed @L148,L160 and checked @L184 is not computed here — comes from USE GLOBAL (L53), labeled 'WetDryMass' in the header text @L147,L159
Energy accumulation @L84-86 is not masked by MASK unlike MassVolume (L80-82) — dry cells still contribute; whether intentional cannot be resolved from this file
Fr reduced with MPI_MAX @L132 independently of UTotalMax @L130 — after reduction Fr may come from a different cell than the global-max UTotal cell; printed Froude=UTotalMax/Fr @L148 mixes the two

declaration initializers =ZERO @L57-59 imply implicit SAVE semantics in Fortran; only MassVolume/Energy/UTotalMax are re-zeroed each call @L69-71 — MaxEta/MinEta/MaxU/MaxV are overwritten @L98-101 so unaffected, but UTotal/Fr retain prior-call values until reassigned (Fr fallback @L115 then masks it)
log unit 3 written @L154-164,L201 without OPEN in this file — unit opened elsewhere (LOG_FILE presumably), not verifiable here
